script: According to the Athletic, Bam Adebayo punches former teammate Tyler Herro without hesitation, leaving a small mark under his left eye. Allegedly and this is just a rumor, the fight happened because of this sleep DM between Tyler Herro and a random Miami Heat fan. The messages are kind of confusing, but to make a long story short, these messages are a discussion between Herro believing Bam was being treated as Miami's franchise player and being paid like one, while Hero got the short end of the stick when they lose. Hero believing Bam was inconsistent and overpaid gets the credit when they win and blame when they lose. This allegedly affected Bam so that they got physical when they met in person. Unclear if things are patched up privately, as say, but Hero just hours later on the same day saying positive things about the Heat organization and his teammates. All love in Miami. You know, I've seen a couple of the guys and the coaching staff, Chris Quinn, Spo, the front office guys. We're all good in Miami and you know, and for the sake of irony, here's an old clip of Bam saying he'll choose T as in Tyler Hero to save him in a street fight. Like if a fight breaks out, who's coming to save you? Not save you, but beat nexst to you. T, just cause we got the longest relationship.
